item.title: World Surf League CEO Ryan Crosby Bashes Olympic Qualification System
item.description: WSL CEO Ryan Crosby released a statement to oppose the newly released Olympic qualification system, accusing the ISA of excluding the tour from negotiations.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn Says Leg Would Have Been Amputated After Olympic Crash If Not for Surgery
item.description: Lindsey Vonn, the famed American skier who crashed in the Olympics just days after tearing her ACL in a World Cup race, says that she nearly lost her left leg.

item.title: Nate Florence Shows the Scale of North Shore Flash Flooding
item.description: Both the North Shore of Oahu and Kauai were hit by huge rainstorms that caused flash flooding. Nate Florence shows the extent of the waters in this video.

item.description: After receiving a significant snow event, California skiers and riders will see unseasonably warm weather in the forecast, with rain at high elevations.

item.title: Utah Teens Who Helped Locate 11-year-old Killed in Avalanche Tell Story
item.description: An 11-year-old died in an avalanche earlier this month. Now, the teen skiers who found her have recounted their experience of attempting to save the girl.

item.title: All 9 Bodies of Castle Peak Avalanche Victims Have Been Recovered, Identified, Says Sheriff
